messages:
Alex M: quick heads-up — doing a quick pager/tooling audit before weekend. I saw a bunch of noisy low-sev latency alerts firing overnight for batch-inference. Proposing small routing + threshold tweaks so oncall noise is reduced but we still get visibility.

Priya S: +1. saw the same. most are ~30–60s spikes during nightly batches. Safe to squelch between 00:00–06:00 UTC?

Kevin L: if we squelch, add a daily digest or metric alert (once/hour) so SRE can still track trend. I can change PD rules but want exact rule text.

Alex M: plan suggestion:
- squelch `batch-inference/request-latency` (sev3) 00:00–06:00 UTC
- raise threshold from 2000ms -> 3000ms for noise-prone endpoints in that window
- route remaining sev2+ to eng-oncall; route sev3 to eng-runtime (on-call) with digest

Samir: route change sounds good, but can we keep a short runbook attached so whoever gets the page knows it's expected during nightly processing? (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batch-inference)

Priya S: yes — add runbook link and a short suppress note: "expected nightly batch, check job queue and GPU utilization". Also mark as editable rollback if burst > 10/min.

Kevin L: will implement. Draft PD filter snippet I plan to apply (for infra-alerts repo):
```
# PagerDuty filter (pseudo)
if alert.service == "batch-inference" and alert.severity == "sev3" and time_in_window("00:00-06:00 UTC"):
  route -> "eng-runtime" with digest(1h)
elif alert.severity >= "sev2":
  route -> "eng-oncall"
```
I'll open a tiny PR with the actual YAML and tests.

Alex M: thx. timeline?

Kevin L: aiming to push PR + apply at 1967893723 (approx 10:30 PST) unless anyone objects by EOD. Will include a Slack #ops-note ping.

Priya S: no objections from me. I'll update the runbook and add the digest alert (simple Prom alert) to keep hourly counts.

Samir: fyi — I'll re-tag the noisy endpoint in tracing so we can correlate spikes to job windows next week.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall coverage this weekend — Primary: Priya S, Backup: Kevin L. Use /hand-off to confirm.

Alex M: cool. Kevin, can you also add a small commit to mute non-actionable logs (grep filter) in the batch agent? tiny change, should reduce noise downstream.

Kevin L: yep. will include that in the same PR. tagging @Priya S for runbook review.

Priya S: ack. thanks all. I'll follow up Monday with observed digest counts.

Alex M: thanks team :thumbsup:
